slug: 2026-06-23 Bimonthly Update on Privacy in Africa (January & February 2026)

facts.fact: Tech Hive Advisory reports in its January and February 2026 update that Mauritius approved the adoption of its National AI Strategy, supported by FAIR guidelines; no day is given, so the update's period of 2026 is used.

note: The National Data Strategy 2025-2029 is not an AI strategy; no body or funding stated.
